user_requirement: The full dashboard must support an approximately two-minute presentation of the decision process while preserving analytical depth and exploration.
timing_status: Proposed pacing; actual rehearsal has not been performed. This is not a measured completion time or a rigid automatic cutoff.
audience_should_understand: What problem and aircraft constraints the original case sets.
Which inputs are observations, estimates or scenarios, and how to inspect their sources.
Which hub and direct-route alternatives were evaluated, how competitors affect the analysis, and why programmes advance or are rejected.
How one common demand, seat inventory, fleet and funding model connects the components into a programme.
Which changes of conditions alter the result and what action the strategy takes.
What the 2027–2028 programme contributes to the whole-business strategy and what remains to reach number two.

stops.show: Goal, period, available resource, principal input sources and coverage; distinguish observations, estimates and scenarios.
stops.audience_takeaway: We allocate constrained aircraft to growth; the standalone Superjet case is preserved.
stops.data_binding: Pinned final input version and standalone Superjet scope.

stops.show: Comparable alternatives, one selected programme and its key demand, competition, resource and uncertainty evidence.
stops.audience_takeaway: A city score is screening; selection depends on a specific programme and its conditions.
stops.data_binding: Actual final shortlist and evaluated programmes; no city is predetermined by this script.

stops.show: One or two decision-relevant products, passenger alternatives and the complete aircraft rotation on comparable resource.
stops.audience_takeaway: Direct products contribute to the choice; both demand and competing supply affect their result.
stops.data_binding: Evaluated physical airport pairs and programme-level results.

stops.show: Combined network against KEEP, monthly resource and funding, followed by one material precomputed stress and the resulting action.
stops.audience_takeaway: Components share demand and aircraft; the recommendation changes or remains robust for an explainable reason.
stops.data_binding: One final programme plus a real computed comparison scenario. Choose a consequential competitor-response or delivery scenario after results exist.

stops.show: Contribution of stage one, remaining scale gap, roadmap and one concrete digital/commercial mechanism with its conditions.
stops.audience_takeaway: The regional programme is a first stage; further growth and uncertain fleet extensions remain explicit conditions.
stops.data_binding: The same primary programme/scenario and the integrated whole-business bridge.

ui_contract.compact_navigation: Keep the agreed section navigation; a compact optional guided route may select the relevant existing states.
ui_contract.controls: Start, previous, next and exit only if they help the rehearsed flow; native focus and keyboard behaviour remain usable.
ui_contract.preset: A named, versioned state selecting real programme/scenario results, not a copy of the dataset or a predetermined winning city.
ui_contract.comparison_state: Keep the primary scenario identifiable while showing a stress comparison; preserve a consistent state on the strategy section.
ui_contract.scenario_overview: A compact view of evaluated delivery, market and competitor-response branches is available; the short walk demonstrates one material branch without reducing the underlying scenario set.
ui_contract.source_access: A visible value opens its particular source, method, period and assumptions without losing the current comparison.
ui_contract.full_exploration: Exit the route at any point, inspect other cities, routes, assumptions or scenarios, and return to the saved presentation state.
ui_contract.scenario_changes: Only display computed results. Unsupported combinations remain visibly uncomputed; a price control must not imply a recalculated demand response when none exists.
ui_contract.important_limits: Relevant uncertainty, negative economics and conditions that change the choice remain visible in the short presentation.
ui_contract.legibility: Key comparisons are readable on a projected screen; detailed tables remain available in the same interface.
ui_contract.stability: The prepared presentation runs on pinned local results and necessary assets; transitions do not require external data collection or new optimisation.

acceptance.depth_policy: If the route is slow or unclear, improve hierarchy, navigation and choice of example rather than removing substantive calculations or concealing conditions.
acceptance.presentation_readiness: Not established by this specification or by green model tests; requires rehearsal in the implemented dashboard.
